properties.displayName: Harbourline AI guardrail: AI accounts should not be reachable from the public internet
properties.description: Flags Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts whose public network access is Enabled and whose network ACL default action is not Deny. Compliant designs use private endpoints (publicNetworkAccess=Disabled) or an IP allow-list. Assigned as Audit in the course because the demo laptop and APIM v2 (no VNet) must reach the account; switch to Deny once private endpoints are in place. Same aliases as the built-in 'Azure AI Services resources should restrict network access'.
